description:
APPLICATION FOR VARIATION OF CONDITION 2 ATTACHED TO LBM PLANNING
APPLICATION 25/P1089 FOR ERECTION OF A ROOF EXTENSION TO EXISTING FIRST FLOOR
FLAT OVER MAIN SECTION AND ROOF TERRACE OVER PART OF OUTRIGGER. RAISING RIDGE
HEIGHT BY 286MM. CHANGES RELATE TO REPLACEING THE 1.7M HIEGH OBSCURE GLASS
BALUSTRADE WITH A 600MM LOW LEVEL WALL WITH A 1.1M HIGH OBSCURE GLASS
BALUSTRADE ON TOP.
decision_conditions: <p>The conditions applicable to the original permission 25/P1089 are applicable to this permission hereby granted with the exception of condition 2 of that original permission.</p><p><u>Reason</u>:&nbsp; For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.&nbsp;</p>
